desktop-tool-connector.title: Local connection
desktop-tool-connector.help: Connect this computer to the current project to use its installed tool.
desktop-tool-connector.renewing: Checking and renewing the original local authorization…
desktop-tool-connector.recovering: Checking original receipts for saved execution results…
desktop-tool-connector.reading_recovery: Reading the original receipt recovery state…
desktop-tool-connector.renewal_unknown: The original renewal is unconfirmed. Check that renewal; its identity and request are retained.
desktop-tool-connector.unknown: The original result is unconfirmed. Check the original connection before continuing; its record stays on this computer.
desktop-tool-connector.needs_workspace: Choose and bind the current project's Git folder, then connect this computer.
desktop-tool-connector.not_installed: This tool is not installed. Install it, then read the connection again.
desktop-tool-connector.unavailable: Local setup is not ready. Check the Git workspace, committed baseline, ignored cache and tool installation, then read the connection state again.
desktop-tool-connector.prepared: The original connection is prepared. Resume it to continue.
desktop-tool-connector.issuance_unknown: The original connection needs checking. A new node will not be issued here.
desktop-tool-connector.starting: Local node is starting. Waiting for a fresh tool report.
desktop-tool-connector.connected: Local node connected. Tool configuration still requires separate registration and enablement.
desktop-tool-connector.stopping: Waiting for the local node to confirm shutdown…
desktop-tool-connector.stopped: Local node shutdown confirmed. Check each run for its task outcome.
desktop-tool-connector.authorization_req: Check current account permissions and the node credential expiry. Expired credentials require new authorization.
desktop-tool-connector.binding_changed: The project folder binding changed. Check the original connection before reconnecting.
desktop-tool-connector.origin_changed: The service address changed. Check the original connection at its original service.
desktop-tool-connector.credential_unreco: The original node credential cannot be recovered. An authorized administrator must resolve the original node before a new connection.
desktop-tool-connector.stop_unconfirmed: Stop is unconfirmed. Check the original connection and affected runs.
desktop-tool-connector.failed: The local connection could not complete. Check its original state before continuing.
desktop-tool-connector.workspace_reading: Reading the current project folder binding…
desktop-tool-connector.workspace_failed: The project folder binding could not be read. Check your access and try again.
desktop-tool-connector.boundary: This connection starts only this project's local node. Tool login, model access and task outcomes are checked separately.
